scope: Android/Termux operational harness only; runtime implementation is indexed but not owned by this harness lane.

operatorCommands.humanScrollbackFallback: Ctrl+B then [; use PgUp/PgDn/arrows; q exits copy mode

knownTraps: Android long-press selection may visually cross tmux split panes; do not use native selection as the primary evidence boundary.
Touch scrolling may not address tmux history predictably; use bounded capture-pane for evidence and tmux copy mode only for human browsing.
A pane displaying authentication/device-code material is sensitive; do not capture it to a durable artifact or share it.
Literal [200~ before a pasted command is input framing evidence, not proof that the intended executable is absent.
Keep Git repositories under Termux $HOME, not shared storage.
Generated evidence is untracked and must not contain credentials or private SSH key material.
The harness indexes the merged Android runtime but must not mutate runtime/product files in a harness-only sprint.

buildTestDeploy.build: No separate build; JSON/Markdown/shell harness assets are tracked source.
buildTestDeploy.deploy: Merge reviewed harness changes; no implicit hook install and no Android package/runtime deployment from this lane.

proofCeiling: Maps tracked ownership, commands and traps only; it does not prove a particular Android UI, clipboard, provider, model, tool invocation or runtime mutation.
